summary: Iteration 3 — Supplier Payments feature verified end-to-end on live Convex (fearless-ostrich-878). Backend 9/9 new tests PASS plus 16/16 regression (25/25 total). Covered GET /api/supplier-payments (owner & accountant 200, newest-first), POST /api/supplier-payments (OWNER only — agent & accountant correctly rejected with 403 'ليس لديك صلاحية'), amount<=0 rejected with 'المبلغ غير صالح', overpayment rejected with Arabic 'المبلغ أكبر من المستحق للمورد (X)', USD path (TEST org has exchange_rate so USD succeeds — code path verified; schema correctly throws 'سعر صرف الدولار' when rate==0), happy-path returns voucher_no prefixed SPY- (SPY-00001..SPY-00004 observed) and reduces owed balance exactly by amount. Frontend (390x844 mobile): owner > المخزون > supplier-statements-button opens supplier-statements-sheet; tapping supplier-row-0 (TEST_SUPPLIER_2fdf13) shows supplier-balance '1,300' and supplier-add-payment-button (visible since balance > 0). Opening supplier-payment-form, filling supplier-payment-amount-input with 999999999 and tapping supplier-payment-save-button keeps form open and shows Arabic error toast 'أكبر من المستحق'. Entering 25 + notes and saving closes the form, balance updates to '1,275' (−25 exact), 4 supplier-payment-row-* entries render (payment-row-0 slot is occupied by newest PURCHASE in timeline — payment rows are at indices 1-4, all showing voucher SPY-00001..SPY-00004). supplier-payment-cancel-button closes form cleanly. Returning to list, supplier-row-0 subtitle shows 'المستحق 1,275' reflecting the new balance; supplier-share-pdf-0 still present. Regression: 4 roles land correctly — owner /owner, acct /acct, agent /dist, dev /dev — no red screens, no Unmatched Route, no pageerrors. No deprecated expo packages found.
critical_code_review_comments: SupplierStatements.tsx line 92: testID `supplier-payment-row-${i}` uses the index into the combined timeline (purchases + returns + payments). When a purchase is the newest row, supplier-payment-row-0 does not exist — payment rows get indices 1,2,...N. Not a bug (testIDs are still unique and renderable), but tests that assume payment-row-0 should be updated to look for any `supplier-payment-row-*`. Observed indices 1-4 in TEST org.

convex/purchases.ts createSupplierPayment: `amount` is stored in base currency after toBase() while `amount_input` keeps the entered value — frontend 'المستحق' subtitle and sheet balance use base currency, so this is correct. Just worth confirming receipts/PDF show the entered currency not the base.
Supplier grouping key still uses raw string normalisation (trim + 'بدون مورد' fallback). Trailing-whitespace / casing duplication risk persists from iteration 2; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Posted 1 supplier payment of 25 SYP via UI (OWNER) and 2 extra via test runs (TEST pay x2) to TEST_SUPPLIER_2fdf13 on org_test_1. Owed balance went from 1,300 → 1,275 after the UI payment. Earlier curl & regression tests added SPY-00001 (100) and SPY-00002/00003 (50 each). TEST org data confined safely.
